sentences.en: Heart disease is one of the leading causes of death worldwide.
sentences.zh: 心脏病是全球范围内导致死亡的主要原因之一。

sentences.en: Regular exercise can help reduce the risk of heart disease.
sentences.zh: 定期锻炼可以帮助降低患心脏病的风险。

sentences.en: She was diagnosed with early-stage heart disease and started a strict diet.
sentences.zh: 她被诊断出患有早期的心脏病，开始严格控制饮食。
